verdict.rationale: Runpod documents explicit lifecycle control—create, start, stop, terminate Pods—via console, CLI (runpodctl), REST API, and GraphQL API, with per-second billing so users only pay for running compute and no charges when stopped/terminated (network volumes persist independently of compute). Community evidence corroborates ease of deployment via templates, though notes execution environment lockdown, which is a minor secondary caveat. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of restart/stop billing behavior beyond docs claims.
